function HashThis pDataToHash,pHashVersion
	local tHashOut
	if pHashVersion = "" then
		get binarydecode("H*",messagedigest(pDataToHash,"sha-256"),tHashOut)
	else
		get binarydecode("H*",messagedigest(pDataToHash,pHashVersion),tHashOut)
	end if
	return tHashOut
end HashThis

function GetAudioFromText pText
	//show_loading "Generating Audio File"
	 local tUrl
	 local tHeadersA
	 local tBodyA
	 local tHeadersJson
	 local tBodyJson
	 local tOldHeaders
	 local tResult
	local tHeaders
	local tAudioData,tBlobID,tFilePath
	
	 // ENDPOINT
	 put "https://api.lemonfox.ai/v1/audio/speech" into tUrl
	
	 // BUILD HEADERS ARRAY
	 put empty into tHeadersA
	 put "Bearer " & "IF9fxDl0RYrWttW7chjeu3JpXE6B8tIG" into tHeadersA["Authorization"]
	 put "application/json" into tHeadersA["Content-Type"]
	
	 // BUILD BODY ARRAY
	 put empty into tBodyA
	 put pText into tBodyA["input"]
	 put textToSpeechVoice into tBodyA["voice"]
	 put textToSpeechLanguage into tBodyA["language"]
	 put "wav" into tBodyA["response_format"]
	 put 1 into tBodyA["speed"]
	 put false into tBodyA["word_timestamps"]
	
	 // CONVERT ARRAYS TO JSON
	 put arrayToJSON(tHeadersA) into tHeadersJson
	 put arrayToJSON(tBodyA) into tBodyJson
	
	 // PRESERVE EXISTING HEADERS
	 put the httpHeaders into tOldHeaders
	
	 // APPLY HEADERS
	 set the httpHeaders to empty
	 put "Authorization: Bearer " & "IF9fxDl0RYrWttW7chjeu3JpXE6B8tIG" & cr after tHeaders
	 put "Content-Type: application/json" & cr after tHeaders
	set the httpheaders to tHeaders
	
	 // POST REQUEST
	 post tBodyJson to url tUrl
	if the result = empty then
		// NO ERROR
		set the httpHeaders to tOldHeaders
		return it
	else
		set the httpHeaders to tOldHeaders
		return empty
	end if
end GetAudioFromText
